name: Sonny Moore Dating Simulator
source: An extremely graphic, absurdist humour novel, [i]Sonny Moore Dating Simulator[/i] follows a new student at dubstep high school, and the various branching paths they can take as they try to befriend and romance the famous dubstep producers who attend the school.
